category: Define and Use Criteria for Software Security Checks (PO)
subcategory_text: Apply the defined criteria to evaluate the security of software throughout the development lifecycle, including during design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
implementation_examples: Run security gates at each lifecycle phase (design review, code review, build, release)
Record pass/fail outcomes with evidence retained for audit
Block release when criteria are not met
assessment_objectives: Determine whether security checks are applied at every lifecycle phase.
Determine whether failing results gate progression to the next phase.
